title: Supplementary materials for Association between dengue cases and entomological indicators of Aedes aegypti in a city in the Peruvian Amazon
description:
Supplementary materials for a test-negative study of dengue and household entomological indicators in Juanjuí, San Martín, Peru. This deposit includes aggregate data, Figures 1–4 and S1, Tables 1–3 and S1–S2, R and Python code, and reproduction instructions. Figure 1 is the original QGIS study map. Access to individual surveillance records requires authorization from the data custodian.

Rights remain with the respective rights holders. Third-party satellite imagery in Figure 1 is subject to its provider's terms.
